prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one independent full-bleed event illustration for a nautical adventure game. Landscape 4:3 composition. Detailed hand-painted painterly realism, confident brushwork, believable weathered wood, bronze, rope, water and cloth. Strong clear main subject readable at 256px thumbnail, rich depth, natural anatomy. Tropical reef sea with bright turquoise blue-green water, dark rocky islets, warm wooden sailing craft, deep blue sky and sunlit clouds unless scene specifies night. Preindustrial age of sail. No text, lettering, logos, UI, title, border, collage, panels, watermark, or modern technology. Make one scene only. The net owner stands on a nearby simple fishing raft urgently waving a plain cloth flag. Focus on net barrier and raised flag, sunny reef sea, no collision or damage.
